caution_supplements.name: Alcohol-containing supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both levocetirizine and alcohol can cause CNS depression and sedation; additive effects may occur
caution_supplements.action: Counsel patient to limit or avoid alcohol-containing herbal preparations and tinctures; monitor for increased drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential for additive CNS effects; theoretical induction of minor metabolic pathways
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for changes in efficacy or increased sedation; consider alternative if CNS depression occurs

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression leading to increased drowsiness, impaired cognition, and reduced alertness
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid or limit alcohol consumption; do not drive or operate machinery if combined use occurs

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay absorption and peak plasma concentrations of levocetirizine
caution_foods.action: Administer on an empty stomach or with light meals for optimal absorption; food does not significantly reduce efficacy

monitoring_notes: Levocetirizine has minimal drug metabolism via CYP450 enzymes and is primarily eliminated unchanged renally, resulting in very few significant interactions. Monitor renal function in elderly patients and those with renal impairment, as reduced clearance may increase drug accumulation and adverse effects.
